chart_insights.auditor_changes: Auditor changes remained stable at 1–4 per year from 2015–2023, then doubled to 11 in both 2025 and 2026, suggesting either a scheduled audit cycle shift or a policy change triggering simultaneous transitions across the CA population.

chart_insights.detection_rate: In-period detection caught 130 of 419 non-compliances (31%), but individual auditors range from 0% to 100%, indicating major disparities in audit quality or scope that create inconsistent oversight across the ecosystem.
chart_insights.etsi_aal: Five ETSI CAs still use version 2.0 or 2.9, released before 2020, despite v3.3 being superseded in 2022 and v3.5 becoming mandatory in March 2026; meanwhile, 9 CAs have adopted v3.5 and 15 use the currently compliant v3.4, showing a fragmented migration with a 4-year lag at the oldest end.
